avis.titre: If you got oily skin already...
avis.texte: Since I moved to another type of climate, my face is pink and dry. Typically my face would be nice and oily, so I would never need moisturizer, but I guess that all changes, too, since I have been getting older. The problem is, and just like my 66-year-old mother, she gets oily skin. And there have been times where I have accumulated a couple pimples here and there, every so often from using this moisturizer. I mean, my skin looks a lot more radiant, but just watch out, because if you don’t have extremely dry skin, then it could pose problems on the pimple level. Edit: June 2019 I have been using this now for the past couple months, and I can say, I love the fact that it protects me from the sun, it also gives me a glow, during times when my skin is completely dry from using soaps to clean my face. However, I still have to avoid answering areas, as it has been giving me pimples. So I can definitely say if you are pimples or acne prone, you may want to find something else.

Laroche-Posay was recommended to me by a friend who works in a high end cosmetic store. It surprised me that she recommended a brand that wasn’t even sold in the store that she works in as I was expecting her to recommend a high end brand. I ran out of the original facial moisturizer and decided to try the spf combo, and I won’t lie, the texture isn’t as smooth or luxurious as the one without it. But it makes getting ready for the day so convenient to have it combined with my daily moisturizer. It’s perfect for my dry skin and goes on kind of on the thin side. Looks great under make up and I think is doing a good join protecting my skin. By far my favorite moisturizer and I have used a lot of different moisturizers!

avis.titre: Great UV moisturizer - still a little greasy on oily skin but works well
avis.texte: Toleriane UV moisturizer is one of the better moisturizers with sunscreen that I've tried, but as an oily skin girly I do have some gripes. Compared to the gel type moisturizers I typically use during the day, this does leave a slightly heavy, greasy feel on the skin (but still quite better than other UV moisturizers on the market). The texture while applying feels thinner/ milkier than most sunscreens. It does have a distinct sunscreen smell but not too offensive. It leaves no white cast, and it hasn't caused breakouts - which can't be said of other UV moisturizers l've used.

avis.titre: Very Moisturizing and Not Shiny- Absorbs Quickly, Feels Natural all Day
avis.texte: This is another great cream by La Roche-Posay. I have been using their anti-aging facial serum lotion for about a month in the evenings La Roche-Posay Substiane Visible Density and Volume Replenishing Anti-Aging Facial Serum, and have been very impressed with the results as well. The night serum always leaves my middle-aged face feeling smooth and soft. This UV sunscreen Double Repair also leaves my face feeling similarly natural and moisturized, with the added benefit of sun protection. I use this on my cleansed face in the morning, as a base for my makeup. It holds my makeup well, and makes my face look more natural and healthy. This feeling lasts all day for me, and my face doesn't get sticky or shiny over time like some sunscreens I have used. I am very pleased with the La Roche-Posay products I have tried so far, and have to say that their relatively higher prices have been worth it.

I absolutely love the sunscreen. I’ve been using it for over two years now it’s lightweight and it doesn’t feel slimy or greasy on your face. I even use it on my neck and shoulders.

avis.titre: Incredible Daily Moisturizer with SPF Protection!
avis.texte: An incredible daily facial moisturizer! The cream is very light, leaving my skin feeling soft and protected all day long. I love the subtle, pleasant scent—it’s not overpowering at all. One of the best features is its longevity; a little goes a long way, making it last for a long time. The added SPF is a fantastic bonus, providing essential UV protection without any greasy residue. If you're looking for a light, effective, and long-lasting moisturizer, this is definitely the one to choose. Highly recommended!
